# hyperfluid_virtual_machine_user (Resource)

A guest OS account of a `hyperfluid_virtual_machine`, applied by its guest agent. Every change replaces the account. Import it as `<vm_id>/<user_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "deploy_ssh_public_key" {
  type = string
}

resource "hyperfluid_secret" "deploy_ssh_key" {
  name             = "web/deploy-ssh-key"
  secret_type      = "plaintext"
  value            = var.deploy_ssh_public_key
  value_wo_version = "1"
}

# Waits for the guest agent of the virtual machine to apply the key.
resource "hyperfluid_virtual_machine_user" "deploy" {
  virtual_machine            = hyperfluid_virtual_machine.web.id
  username                   = "deploy"
  ssh_public_key_secret_name = hyperfluid_secret.deploy_ssh_key.name
}

# The generated password is kept in the secret manager, never in state.
resource "hyperfluid_virtual_machine_user" "ops" {
  virtual_machine   = hyperfluid_virtual_machine.web.id
  username          = "ops"
  generate_password = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) Account name: a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits, `_` or `-`.
- `virtual_machine` (String) Virtual machine id.

### Optional

- `generate_password` (Boolean) Generate a password, kept in the secret manager and never in state.
- `ssh_public_key_secret_name` (String) Name of an organization-wide plaintext `hyperfluid_secret` holding the SSH public key to authorize.
- `tags` (List of String) User-defined tags.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase, `Ready` once the guest applied the credentials.
- `slug` (String) Derived slug.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Virtual machine user import id is "<vm_id>/<user_id>".
terraform import hyperfluid_virtual_machine_user.deploy 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111
```
